ET-100001.title: Appointment of a service provider for the refurbishment of office buildings in Pretoria
ET-100001.description: The Department of Public Works and Infrastructure invites suitably qualified service providers to refurbish office buildings in the Pretoria CBD, including electrical, mechanical and civil works.
ET-100001.organisation: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure

ET-100002.title: Supply, delivery and installation of network infrastructure equipment
ET-100002.description: SITA requires a service provider to supply, deliver and install core and edge network infrastructure equipment across multiple government sites.
ET-100002.briefingText: A compulsory virtual briefing session will be held on 15 September 2026 at 10:00.
